search_log: fetched data.sec.gov submissions CIK0001131399 (recent + 3 history pages, 2001-2026): 6,124 6-K and 39 6-K/A filings; 20-F 25

2003-2011: fetched every 6-K filed in the 4 results windows each year and kept those whose text contains 'Seretide' and 'turnover' (40 documents matched, 4 of them excluded below; the 2001-2002 6-Ks are paper placeholders on EDGAR)

2012-2026: selected 6-Ks whose primaryDocDescription is 1ST/2ND/3RD QUARTER RESULTS, HALF YEARLY/HALF-YEAR REPORT or FINAL RESULTS; 2012-02-07 6-K (Q4 2011) added by hand because its description is generic ('FORM 6-K')
excluded as duplicates/restatements: 6-K 2004-10-29 and 2005-02-10 (IFRS restatements of 2003-2004), 6-K 2008-05-06 (second filing of the Q1 2008 release), 2008-02-07 text-only copy of Q4 2007

per release: product row taken from the 'Pharmaceuticals/Vaccines turnover' regional tables (Total column = worldwide); each quarter cross-checked: Q1+Q2 = printed six-month row, +Q3 = printed nine-month row, +Q4 = printed full-year row
